chose: A decision question draws on a recorded call in docs/calls.json, least recently asked first and newest first among those never asked. A merged pull request reaches a question only through the call that records its decision (the call's refs); a merged pull request with no call is not a source.
options: (a) recorded calls only, the pull requests reached through their refs
(b) calls and merged pull requests alike, a pull request by its title
(c) pull requests with their bodies fetched for the chosen one
gray: #2935 names both calls and merged pull requests as sources.
